about: Bitcoin-only companies and projects shown on the Ecosystem page. Rule: products support Bitcoin (on-chain, Lightning or Bitcoin layers) and no other cryptocurrency or token. Each entry links the page that supports the claim. 'verification': 'read' = official page or repository read directly; 'search' = checked through a search tool summary of the official domain, to be re-read before final validation. 'review': 'pending' until an editor of this edition validates the entry.

companies.name: Muun

description.en: Self-custodial 2-of-2 multisig mobile wallet for bitcoin and Lightning payments.
description.fr: Portefeuille mobile en auto-garde, multisig 2 sur 2, pour paiements bitcoin et Lightning.

companies.evidenceNote: Site and README (github.com/muun/apollo) describe a non-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning wallet; terms name Muun Wallet Inc., incorporated in the Cayman Islands.

companies.name: Sparrow Wallet

description.en: Open-source desktop Bitcoin wallet focused on security, privacy and hardware wallet support.
description.fr: Portefeuille Bitcoin desktop open source axé sur la sécurité, la confidentialité et les portefeuilles matériels.

companies.evidenceNote: README: 'Sparrow is a modern desktop Bitcoin wallet application'; no other assets supported (no explicit 'bitcoin-only' wording).

companies.name: Wizardsardine (Liana)

description.en: Developer of Liana, an open-source Bitcoin wallet with timelocked recovery and inheritance paths.
description.fr: Développeur de Liana, portefeuille Bitcoin open source avec chemins de récupération et de succession temporisés.

companies.evidenceNote: README: 'Liana is a simple Bitcoin wallet' with a recovery key usable after inactivity; site tagline 'Bitcoin infrastructure, on your own terms'.

companies.name: ZEUS

description.en: Open-source mobile wallet for Bitcoin and Lightning with an embedded node or remote node connection.
description.fr: Portefeuille mobile open source Bitcoin et Lightning, avec nœud intégré ou connexion à un nœud distant.

companies.evidenceNote: README feature list includes '[x] Bitcoin only wallet'; AGPLv3, Lightning, on-chain and Cashu ecash.

companies.name: Bitkey

description.en: Self-custody bitcoin wallet combining a hardware device, a mobile app and 2-of-3 multisig.
description.fr: Portefeuille bitcoin en auto-garde associant un boîtier, une application mobile et un multisig 2 sur 3.

companies.evidenceNote: Terms: 'the Services are only compatible with Bitcoin'; site calls it a Bitcoin-only 2-of-3 multisig wallet. Operated by Block, Inc.

companies.name: Coinkite (COLDCARD)

description.en: Canadian maker of the COLDCARD air-gapped signing device and other bitcoin hardware.
description.fr: Fabricant canadien du dispositif de signature isolé COLDCARD et d'autres matériels bitcoin.

companies.evidenceNote: About page presents Coinkite as a Bitcoin-only company with no multi-chain option on COLDCARD; terms list a registered address in Toronto.

companies.name: SeedSigner

description.en: Open-source DIY air-gapped Bitcoin signing device built from low-cost parts.
description.fr: Dispositif de signature Bitcoin isolé, open source et à monter soi-même avec des pièces bon marché.

companies.evidenceNote: README: 'Build an offline, airgapped Bitcoin signing device for less than $50!'

companies.name: 21bitcoin

description.en: Austrian app to buy, save and sell bitcoin, licensed under MiCAR by the FMA.
description.fr: Application autrichienne pour acheter, épargner et vendre du bitcoin, agréée MiCAR par la FMA.

companies.evidenceNote: FIOR Digital GmbH: 'first Austrian Bitcoin-only company with a MiCAR CASP licence'; focuses exclusively on Bitcoin, only BTC accepted.

companies.name: Bitaroo

description.en: Australian bitcoin exchange with an order book, instant buy and custody options.
description.fr: Plateforme d'échange bitcoin australienne avec carnet d'ordres, achat instantané et options de garde.

companies.evidenceNote: About page: 'Australia's biggest Bitcoin-only exchange', 100% Australian owned, operating since 2020.

companies.name: Bitcoin Well

description.en: Listed Canadian company selling bitcoin online and through ATMs, delivered to self-custody.
description.fr: Société canadienne cotée vendant du bitcoin en ligne et par distributeurs, livré en auto-garde.

companies.evidenceNote: Calls itself a bitcoin-only, non-custodial business (TSXV: BTCW) headquartered in Edmonton, Alberta; comparison table 'Bitcoin only' vs 'Hundreds of altcoins'.

companies.name: Bitonic

description.en: Dutch AFM-licensed service to buy and sell bitcoin via iDEAL, including auto-invest.
description.fr: Service néerlandais agréé AFM pour acheter et vendre du bitcoin via iDEAL, avec achat automatique.

companies.evidenceNote: FAQ: 'At Bitonic you can only buy or sell bitcoin (BTC), no other cryptocurrencies'.

companies.name: Bittr

description.en: Swiss service for recurring bitcoin purchases by bank transfer to the user's own wallet.
description.fr: Service suisse d'achat récurrent de bitcoin par virement vers le portefeuille de l'utilisateur.

companies.evidenceNote: BITTR AG states it will never add support for any cryptocurrency other than bitcoin.

companies.name: Bull Bitcoin

description.en: Non-custodial bitcoin exchange and open-source BULL wallet, active in Canada, Europe and Latin America.
description.fr: Plateforme bitcoin non custodiale et portefeuille open source BULL, au Canada, en Europe et en Amérique latine.

companies.evidenceNote: Blog: works exclusively with Bitcoin, 'no altcoins'; wallet marketed as 'self-custodial, open source, Bitcoin only'.

companies.name: Peach Bitcoin

description.en: Peer-to-peer marketplace to buy and sell bitcoin without KYC, using multisig escrow.
description.fr: Place de marché pair-à-pair pour acheter et vendre du bitcoin sans KYC, avec séquestre multisig.

companies.evidenceNote: Terms describe a P2P bitcoin marketplace with 2-of-2 multisig escrow, limits set under Swiss law; only bitcoin is traded (no explicit 'bitcoin-only' wording found).

companies.name: Pocket Bitcoin

description.en: Swiss service to buy bitcoin by bank transfer, delivered to the user's own wallet.
description.fr: Service suisse d'achat de bitcoin par virement, livré dans le portefeuille de l'utilisateur.

companies.evidenceNote: FAQ: Pocket does not support any other cryptocurrency; legal page names Pocket App AG, Lupfig, Switzerland, operator of a bitcoin-only platform.

companies.name: Relai

description.en: Swiss mobile app to buy bitcoin and run savings plans, with keys held by the user.
description.fr: Application suisse pour acheter du bitcoin et programmer une épargne, clés détenues par l'utilisateur.

companies.evidenceNote: Describes itself as a non-custodial Bitcoin-only app based in Switzerland.

companies.name: River

description.en: US bitcoin brokerage offering purchases, custody and interest on cash paid in bitcoin.
description.fr: Courtier bitcoin américain proposant achat, garde et intérêts sur liquidités versés en bitcoin.

companies.evidenceNote: Site describes River as a Bitcoin-only financial platform; FAQ says it does not plan to support other cryptocurrencies. US state money-transmitter licences listed at river.com/legal/licenses.

companies.name: StackinSat

description.en: French-language recurring bitcoin purchase (DCA) service called Plan Épargne Bitcoin.
description.fr: Service francophone d'achat programmé de bitcoin (DCA) appelé Plan Épargne Bitcoin.

companies.evidenceNote: Help centre: savings service 'orienté uniquement sur bitcoin'; no multi-crypto platform planned.

companies.name: Swan Bitcoin

description.en: US platform for recurring bitcoin purchases, bitcoin IRAs and private client services.
description.fr: Plateforme américaine d'achat récurrent de bitcoin, de comptes retraite bitcoin et de services privés.

companies.evidenceNote: Swan's own pages: does not offer altcoins or memecoins, 'Bitcoin only'. A Swan-hosted page gives Los Angeles, California as HQ.

companies.name: Bringin

description.en: European app to sell bitcoin via Lightning or on-chain into a euro IBAN account and card.
description.fr: Application européenne pour vendre du bitcoin via Lightning ou on-chain vers un compte IBAN et une carte en euros.

companies.evidenceNote: Describes itself as a Bitcoin-only app for people in Europe, 'No altcoins'; pitches euro payouts so users need not handle stablecoins.

companies.name: Fold

description.en: App and payment cards that pay spending rewards in bitcoin.
description.fr: Application et cartes de paiement qui versent des récompenses d'achat en bitcoin.

companies.evidenceNote: Rewards terms: bitcoin is the sole form of rewards; card announcement promises 'bitcoin-only rewards without the complexity of tokens'.

companies.name: Machankura

description.en: Service to send and receive bitcoin over USSD on basic phones in several African countries.
description.fr: Service pour envoyer et recevoir du bitcoin par USSD sur téléphones basiques dans plusieurs pays africains.

companies.evidenceNote: Site: send and receive sats to your phone number via USSD; user manual lists Bitcoin/Lightning only.

companies.name: Swiss Bitcoin Pay

description.en: Swiss payment service letting merchants accept bitcoin on-chain and over Lightning.
description.fr: Service de paiement suisse permettant aux commerçants d'accepter le bitcoin on-chain et via Lightning.

companies.evidenceNote: Site: 'Accept Bitcoin in your Business', Lightning and on-chain only, supervised by FINMA; no altcoin support found (no explicit 'bitcoin-only' wording).

companies.name: Tando

description.en: Kenyan app to pay M-Pesa merchants and phone numbers with bitcoin over Lightning.
description.fr: Application kényane pour payer marchands et numéros M-Pesa en bitcoin via Lightning.

companies.evidenceNote: Site: spend bitcoin anywhere M-Pesa is accepted in Kenya, users pay from their own Lightning wallet; terms by Tando Ltd.

companies.name: ACINQ (Phoenix)

description.en: French Lightning Network developer behind the Eclair implementation and the Phoenix wallet.
description.fr: Développeur français du Lightning Network, auteur de l'implémentation Eclair et du portefeuille Phoenix.

companies.evidenceNote: ACINQ describes itself as a French Bitcoin technology company focused on the Lightning Network; Phoenix is a self-custodial Bitcoin Lightning wallet (phoenix.acinq.co).

companies.name: Alby

description.en: Maker of Alby Hub, self-custodial Lightning node and wallet software, plus a browser extension.
description.fr: Éditeur d'Alby Hub, logiciel de nœud et portefeuille Lightning en auto-garde, et d'une extension navigateur.

companies.evidenceNote: Guides describe Alby Hub as self-custodial Lightning wallet software with an on-chain bitcoin wallet; no other assets mentioned.

companies.name: Second

description.en: Developer of Bark, an open-source implementation of the Ark protocol on Bitcoin.
description.fr: Développeur de Bark, implémentation open source du protocole Ark sur Bitcoin.

companies.evidenceNote: Blog/docs: Bark is live on bitcoin mainnet for self-custodial payments over Ark, Lightning and on-chain.

companies.name: MyNode

description.en: Self-hosted Bitcoin and Lightning node platform, as free software or preinstalled hardware.
description.fr: Plateforme de nœud Bitcoin et Lightning auto-hébergé, en logiciel gratuit ou matériel préinstallé.

companies.evidenceNote: README: 'the easiest way to run a dedicated, easy to use, Bitcoin Node and Lightning Wallet'.

companies.name: RaspiBlitz

description.en: Open-source do-it-yourself Bitcoin and Lightning full node for Raspberry Pi.
description.fr: Nœud complet Bitcoin et Lightning open source à monter soi-même sur Raspberry Pi.

companies.evidenceNote: README: 'a do-it-yourself Bitcoin & Lightning Fullnode running on a RaspberryPi'.

companies.name: The Mempool Open Source Project

description.en: Open-source, self-hostable Bitcoin mempool and blockchain explorer with a public API.
description.fr: Explorateur open source et auto-hébergeable du mempool et de la blockchain Bitcoin, avec API publique.

companies.evidenceNote: README: mempool visualizer, explorer and API 'developed and operated for the benefit of the Bitcoin community'. Also offers a Liquid explorer view.

companies.name: Bitaxe (Open Source Miners United)

description.en: Community-built open-source Bitcoin ASIC miner with published hardware and ESP-Miner firmware.
description.fr: Mineur ASIC Bitcoin open source conçu par la communauté, matériel et firmware ESP-Miner publiés.

companies.evidenceNote: Project site and OSMU wiki describe Bitaxe as an open-source Bitcoin miner pairing a Bitcoin ASIC chip with an ESP32-S3.

companies.name: Braiins

description.en: Bitcoin mining company running Braiins Pool and developing Braiins OS firmware for ASIC miners.
description.fr: Entreprise de minage bitcoin exploitant Braiins Pool et développant le firmware Braiins OS pour mineurs ASIC.

companies.evidenceNote: Pool FAQ: you can mine Bitcoin on Braiins Pool; no plans to support altcoins such as Ethereum, Monero, Litecoin or Dogecoin.

companies.name: FutureBit

description.en: Maker of Apollo home Bitcoin miners that also run a full Bitcoin node.
description.fr: Fabricant des mineurs domestiques Apollo qui font aussi tourner un nœud Bitcoin complet.

companies.evidenceNote: Product pages describe Apollo as a Bitcoin ASIC miner and desktop computer running a full node; all products are Bitcoin-focused.

companies.name: OCEAN

description.en: Non-custodial Bitcoin mining pool using TIDES payouts and the DATUM protocol for miner-built templates.
description.fr: Pool de minage Bitcoin non custodial avec paiements TIDES et protocole DATUM de modèles de blocs côté mineur.

companies.evidenceNote: Official DATUM Gateway README (Bitcoin Ocean, LLC): 'Official DATUM supports Bitcoin only, using Bitcoin's consensus rules and SHA-256d proof of work'.

companies.name: Nunchuk

description.en: Multisig self-custody and inheritance platform for bitcoin, with mobile and desktop apps.
description.fr: Plateforme d'auto-garde multisig et de succession pour le bitcoin, avec applications mobiles et desktop.

companies.evidenceNote: FAQ says the company is Bitcoin-only and never has custody of users' bitcoin.

companies.name: Onramp

description.en: Bitcoin platform offering multi-institution 2-of-3 custody, brokerage and related services.
description.fr: Plateforme bitcoin proposant une garde multi-institutionnelle 2 sur 3, du courtage et des services associés.

companies.evidenceNote: Describes itself as a Bitcoin-only platform / 'a bitcoin-only financial platform'.

companies.name: Unchained

description.en: Collaborative multisig custody, bitcoin IRAs, a trading desk and bitcoin-backed loans.
description.fr: Garde multisig collaborative, comptes retraite bitcoin, desk d'achat et prêts adossés au bitcoin.

companies.evidenceNote: Describes itself as bitcoin financial services built on collaborative custody; lending material states 'we are bitcoin-only'. Company pages place HQ in Austin, Texas.

companies.name: Bitcoin Magazine

description.en: Bitcoin news publication founded in 2012, published by BTC Inc.
description.fr: Média d'information sur le Bitcoin fondé en 2012, édité par BTC Inc.

companies.evidenceNote: About page: 'The first publication devoted exclusively to Bitcoin'; published by BTC Inc., a subsidiary of Nakamoto Inc.

companies.name: Btrust

description.en: Organisation funding and training open-source Bitcoin developers, with a focus on Africa.
description.fr: Organisation qui finance et forme des développeurs Bitcoin open source, en particulier en Afrique.

companies.evidenceNote: Site: Btrust Builders training, BitDevs sponsorship and grants for Bitcoin Core, wallets and Lightning work.

companies.name: Mi Primer Bitcoin

description.en: Non-profit Bitcoin education organisation started in El Salvador, known for its Bitcoin Diploma.
description.fr: Association d'éducation Bitcoin née au Salvador, connue pour son Diplôme Bitcoin.

companies.evidenceNote: Site documents Bitcoin-only education programmes (Bitcoin Diploma, online school) begun in El Salvador in 2021.

companies.name: Plan ₿ Network

description.en: Bitcoin education initiative offering free open-source courses, tutorials and local hubs.
description.fr: Initiative d'éducation Bitcoin proposant cours open source gratuits, tutoriels et communautés locales.

companies.evidenceNote: README: aims to build 'the first multilingual and open-source e-learning platform focused on Bitcoin'; content CC BY-SA.

companies.name: Wasabi Wallet

description.en: Open-source desktop Bitcoin wallet with built-in coinjoin and Tor routing.
description.fr: Portefeuille Bitcoin desktop open source avec coinjoin intégré et routage Tor.

companies.evidenceNote: README: 'An open-source, non-custodial, privacy-focused Bitcoin wallet for desktop'; MIT licence.
